CustomField.description: Pipeline Health: AI Insights Score. Health display formula.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL( Opportunity__r.StageName , "Closed Won"), "🟢 Closed Won", IF( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.StageName , "Closed Lost"), "🔴 Closed Lost", IF( Close_Likelihood_Score__c >= 0.70, "🟢 Healthy", IF( Close_Likelihood_Score__c >= 0.45, "🟡 Needs Attention", "🔴 Off Track" ) & " (" & TEXT(ROUND(Close_Likelihood_Score__c * 100, 0)) & "%)" )))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Read-only health indicator derived from milestone scores. Do not edit.
CustomField.label: AI Insights Score
